title: Grain Grower Machinery Investment Guide Launched 0.34 Ratio Explained 0.34 Ratio For Efficient Farm Machinery Investm...
reason: This video describes a project to help grain growers make informed decisions on machinery purchases.

tasks.task: Describe the background and purpose of the GRDC project.

subtasks.text: Explain that machinery purchases are big ticket items for Australian grain growers and vary based on differing opinions.
Highlight that GRDC initiated a two-year project to develop a comprehensive guide for growers in Australia's cropping regions.

tasks.task: Describe how the guide assists growers in making machinery investment decisions.

subtasks.text: Showcase that the guide includes data and 30 case studies from more than 450 growers.
Present an example where a grower chose a used machine due to rising new machinery costs.

tasks.task: Explain the new benchmarking formula featured in the guide.

subtasks.text: Demonstrate that the benchmarking formula calculates machinery investment levels relative to overall farm profit.
Illustrate how the new formula takes into account various factors such as labour, maintenance, and contracting.
Show the benchmark ratio of costs versus gross farm income being about 0.34.
